items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. I think it’s the same exact question about why was he chosen as the spokesman for the Ken Burns thing? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah right.

ctx.x: Rutgers. He’s retired now and has gone back to playing. There are other people I can think of who to me are the wise men of the music, the giants.
Yeah. I think it’s the same exact question about why was he chosen as the spokesman for the Ken Burns thing?
